title: 门店体验牵涉多个部门，怎样推动协同？
topic: 把分散职能纳入共同目标并加快门店方案落地

source.title: McDonald’s Creates New Restaurant Experience Team
source.section: McDonald’s Creates New Restaurant Experience Team
source.type: 麦当劳官方组织调整与业务战略说明
source.context: McDonald’s 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: In a bold move to double down on the best restaurant experience in the industry, McDonald’s has introduced a new Restaurant Experience Team. This exciting development for our business, McFamily, and System will move vision and big ideas to execution, with even greater speed.

The new team will bring together Operations, Supply Chain, Franchising, Development, Restaurant Design, Delivery, and Speedee Labs. Additionally, it will establish three new global Category Management teams focused on beef, chicken, and beverages/desserts.

There’s strong competition within the QSR industry and success is determined by our ability to gain share. In many markets, McDonald’s is competing against specialists. We’re bringing a specialist’s focus into our operations. Setting up dedicated category teams on beef, chicken and beverages/desserts will allow better accountability and execution to win with our core menu.

We’re tackling integrated challenges, together, right out of the gate. With menu innovation and more tech initiatives rolling out across our restaurants every single day, this new team will allow us to execute faster – which means we can get great solutions that work for our restaurants into more places with more speed.

Since introducing our Accelerating the Arches growth strategy, we’ve made tremendous progress and are already seeing those benefits. We’ve grown our digital footprint to over 175 million 90-day active users across 60 markets, generating approximately $30 billion in systemwide sales to loyalty members in 2024. We’ve expanded with new restaurants at a faster rate than we have in decades and scaled global menu innovation to hundreds of markets around the world.

With our Restaurant Experience Team, we’re bringing that vision directly into our restaurants. Thinking about creating an exceptional restaurant experience – from our food to our equipment to our operations – through the lens of a restaurant general manager to ensure all of our big ideas are working together.
translations: 麦当劳新设餐厅体验团队，进一步聚焦打造行业领先的餐厅体验。这一调整将帮助公司及其加盟体系更快把愿景和创意转化为行动。
新团队将汇集运营、供应链、加盟、开发、餐厅设计、配送和 Speedee Labs。此外，公司还将建立三个全球品类管理团队，分别关注牛肉、鸡肉以及饮品和甜品。
快餐行业竞争激烈，能否提升市场份额决定了成败。在许多市场，麦当劳正与专门聚焦某些品类的竞争者较量。我们希望把这种专注带入自身运营。设立牛肉、鸡肉和饮品/甜品专门团队，将有助于明确责任并推动执行，在核心菜单上赢得竞争。
我们从一开始就在共同处理彼此关联的挑战。菜单创新和技术项目每天都在更多餐厅推出，新团队将帮助我们更快执行，让适用于餐厅的好方案更快推广到更多地方。
自从推出“加速拱门”增长战略以来，我们取得了显著进展，并开始看到收益。数字业务覆盖范围已扩大到 60 个市场的 1.75 亿多名 90 天活跃用户，2024 年会员体系贡献了约 300 亿美元的系统销售额。公司以几十年来更快的速度开设新餐厅，并将全球菜单创新推广到数百个市场。
通过餐厅体验团队，我们把这一愿景直接带到餐厅。我们从餐厅总经理的视角思考如何打造出色体验——涵盖食物、设备和运营——确保各项创意能够协同发挥作用。
fullTextParagraphs: In a bold move to double down on the best restaurant experience in the industry, McDonald’s has introduced a new Restaurant Experience Team. This exciting development for our business, McFamily, and System will move vision and big ideas to execution, with even greater speed.

The new team will bring together Operations, Supply Chain, Franchising, Development, Restaurant Design, Delivery, and Speedee Labs. Additionally, it will establish three new global Category Management teams focused on beef, chicken, and beverages/desserts.
Why is McDonald’s doing this now?

There’s strong competition within the QSR industry and success is determined by our ability to gain share. In many markets, McDonald’s is competing against specialists. We’re bringing a specialist’s focus into our operations. Setting up dedicated category teams on beef, chicken and beverages/desserts will allow better accountability and execution to win with our core menu.

We’re tackling integrated challenges, together, right out of the gate. With menu innovation and more tech initiatives rolling out across our restaurants every single day, this new team will allow us to execute faster – which means we can get great solutions that work for our restaurants into more places with more speed.

Since introducing our Accelerating the Arches growth strategy, we’ve made tremendous progress and are already seeing those benefits. We’ve grown our digital footprint to over 175 million 90-day active users across 60 markets, generating approximately $30 billion in systemwide sales to loyalty members in 2024. We’ve expanded with new restaurants at a faster rate than we have in decades and scaled global menu innovation to hundreds of markets around the world.
Accelerating the Organization is making us sharper and faster, with integrated strategies for shared goals.

With our Restaurant Experience Team, we’re bringing that vision directly into our restaurants. Thinking about creating an exceptional restaurant experience – from our food to our equipment to our operations – through the lens of a restaurant general manager to ensure all of our big ideas are working together.

We have the right leadership with rich and relevant experience, here within the business. ATO has promised bigger and more challenging roles for development. We’re giving new experiences to proven McDonald’s leaders to excel in the areas that matter most. Our talent pipeline is delivering exceptional results. Evolving our structure like this is good for our leaders and good for the business.
To read the message sent to the McDonald’s System today, click here.

notes.phrase: bring together Operations, Supply Chain, Franchising, Development, Restaurant Design, Delivery, and Speedee Labs
notes.meaning: 把运营、供应链、加盟、开发、餐厅设计、配送和 Speedee Labs 汇集到一个团队。
notes.explain: bring together + 多个团队，表示把原本分散的职能纳入共同协作。
notes.example: The new launch team brings together marketing, sales, and operations.

notes.phrase: Setting up dedicated category teams on beef, chicken and beverages/desserts will allow better accountability and execution
notes.meaning: 为牛肉、鸡肉、饮品和甜品设立专门品类团队，明确责任并推动执行。
notes.explain: dedicated category teams 聚焦具体品类；accountability 指责任归属清楚。
notes.example: A dedicated category owner will improve accountability for the menu.

notes.phrase: this new team will allow us to execute faster
notes.meaning: 新团队的目标之一是加快执行。
notes.explain: execute faster 把组织调整和门店方案更快落地联系起来。
notes.example: The cross-functional group will help us execute faster.

scenario.title: 餐饮项目：多个团队共同改善高峰期服务
english: A restaurant group wants to reduce wait times during lunch while keeping menu quality consistent.
Operations, supply chain, restaurant design, delivery, and digital teams each own part of the customer experience.
Propose a cross-functional team with clear category owners, and explain how to test solutions from the restaurant manager’s perspective.
chinese: 一家餐饮集团希望缩短午餐高峰等待时间，同时保持菜单品质稳定。
运营、供应链、餐厅设计、配送和数字团队分别负责顾客体验的一部分。
请提出跨部门团队和明确的品类负责人，并说明如何从餐厅经理的视角测试方案。

firstAttempt.prompt: 改善门店体验需要运营、供应链、设计和配送共同参与。请用英语说明为何要组建跨部门团队、如何明确责任，以及怎样让方案适用于门店。
firstAttempt.sample: We should bring Operations, Supply Chain, Franchising, Development, Restaurant Design, Delivery, and Speedee Labs into one Restaurant Experience Team. Three global category teams will cover beef, chicken, and beverages and desserts. Clear ownership will improve accountability and help teams execute menu changes faster. Before scaling a solution, we should review it from a restaurant general manager’s perspective to make sure food, equipment, and operations work together.
firstAttempt.rationale: 从顾客体验目标出发，把相关职能汇集起来，明确负责范围，并在真实门店条件下验证方案。

words.example: The project brings together operations, design, and delivery.
words.translation: 这个项目把运营、设计和配送团队联合起来。
words.note: 说明不同职能共同参与一项工作。

words.example: Clear owners improve accountability for each menu category.
words.translation: 明确负责人能强化各菜单品类的责任归属。
words.note: 用于说明谁负责某项结果或工作。

words.example: The new team can execute store improvements faster.
words.translation: 新团队可以更快落实门店改进。
words.note: 在商业语境中常指把计划变成具体行动。

taskPhrases.example: The team brings together operations, supply chain, and design.
taskPhrases.translation: 团队汇集了运营、供应链和设计等职能。

taskPhrases.example: Clear category owners improve accountability for each menu category.
taskPhrases.translation: 明确各菜单品类的负责人，有助于落实相应责任。

taskPhrases.example: A shared team helps us execute store changes faster.
taskPhrases.translation: 共同团队能帮助我们更快落实门店调整。

structure.original: Setting up dedicated category teams on beef, chicken and beverages/desserts will allow better accountability and execution to win with our core menu.
analysis: Setting up… 是动名词短语作主语，指“设立专门团队”这项做法。
will allow better accountability and execution 说明组织设计带来的直接作用。
to win with our core menu 说明最终业务目标。
structure.transfer: Setting up a dedicated onboarding team will allow clearer ownership and faster execution.

rewrite.bad: Everyone should work together better and make the restaurants great.
rewrite.good: We should bring Operations, Supply Chain, Menu, and Digital into one breakfast experience team. Each function should own a clear workstream, with one lead accountable for the overall customer experience. Clear ownership improves accountability and helps the team execute changes faster. We can test the process in three stores, review wait time and order accuracy, and scale it if results hold.
rewrite.translation: 我们应把运营、供应链、菜单和数字团队纳入一个早餐体验小组。每个职能负责一条明确的工作流，并由一位负责人对整体顾客体验负责。明确的分工能加强责任落实，帮助团队更快执行调整。我们可以先在三家门店测试，检查等候时间和点单准确率，结果稳定后再扩大范围。
rewrite.pattern: We should bring [functions] together. Clear owners for [area] will improve accountability. We should test [change] from [frontline user]’s perspective before scaling.

cloze.prompt: The team will bring ______ Operations, Supply Chain, and Design.
cloze.why: bring teams together 表示把不同团队联合起来。
accountability 指清楚的责任归属。

cloze.prompt: A shared team helps us ______ store changes faster.
cloze.why: execute a change 指把改变落实到行动。

choice.prompt: 门店等待时间过长，涉及排班、备货、菜单和外卖接单。哪种做法更可能解决整体问题？
options: Ask each department to optimize its own metric without a shared owner.
Bring the relevant functions into one team, assign owners for key workstreams, and test changes during a real service shift.
Redesign the menu before checking supply and store operations.
choice.why: 第二条明确共同目标、责任分工和真实门店验证，避免各部门只优化局部。

output.prompt: 你向负责人提议成立一个改善门店早餐体验的小组，成员包括运营、供应链、菜单和数字团队。请说明责任分工，并提出如何先验证再扩展。
output.sample: We should bring Operations, Supply Chain, Menu, and Digital into one breakfast experience team. Each function should own a clear workstream, with one lead accountable for the overall customer experience. We can test the new process in three stores, review wait time and order accuracy from the restaurant manager’s perspective, and scale it if the results hold.
check: 说出共同目标与参与职能
明确各职能的责任和牵头人
提出门店试点及推广依据

blockers: 人工听审音频并核对台词、停顿和语速
